summary: Shadow Bolt Affliction: Shadow Mastery, Pandemic, Malevolence and Nightfall with Improved Shadow Bolt, Ruin and Agonizing Flames, Succubus out. The best 30-point Affliction build; a Wrack/drain DoT spec was dropped as 55+ DPS behind with the same playstyle.
rotation: Pre-pull: Shadow Bolt at -2.5 s (lands just after the pull)
Life Tap below 5% mana or when the filler costs more than the mana left
Bane of Doom when it lands before the fight ends (more than 60 s left)
Bane of Agony while Bane of Doom is on cooldown or would not land
Corruption when it is down (more than 9 s left)
Immolate when down or when less than its cast time remains
Shadow Bolt as the filler (instant on Nightfall procs)
caveats: Two synthetic item level 71 trinkets (Forever's launch trinkets aren't simulated): 38 spell power and 13 crit rating, and 140 spell power for 20 s every 2 min, used in the opening seconds and again on cooldown
Demon sensitivity: no owner scaling 937.0, Succubus melee halved 938.7, both 913.8 (first set)
Wrack/Siphon Life DoT variant (25530000035001351--0550005003) is 55 behind; drain fillers 124 to 349 behind
Demon scaling uses Season of Discovery placeholder coefficients (Forever's are server-side): worth +49 on Demonology, +39 on the other builds
Succubus base melee is unverified: halved melee would cost Demonology 43, the other builds 38 to 39
Bane of Doom coefficient 4.0 (Era 1.0) is about 12% of Shadow Bolt builds' damage; at 2.0 they lose about 4%, at 1.0 about 6%
No Ahn'Qiraj book ranks (Shadow Bolt IX, Immolate VII, Corruption VI): 7 to 13 DPS below rank X/VIII/VII
Only the Demonheart Raiment 2-piece is live (the 5-piece added about +8 to +13 on the first set)
Soul shards and Life Tap health cost are not tracked
notes: Request straight from mksettings -spec affliction -gear level60_phase1_synthetic -apl level60_affliction -race Gnome -duration 180, no edits. Demon Armor; Summon Succubus, sacrificed NoSummon, imbue Spellstone. mksettings sets distanceFromTarget 5 / channelClipDelayMs 50 where the UI preset uses 25 / 150; the published numbers were made with mksettings and reproduce exactly.
